beginner.headline: Tomorrow (Sun Oct 11): conditional for beginners; lower confidence than a same-morning report, the morning on-site check decides. Long-period south reinforcement (19 s forerunners on Surfline this evening) peaks Sunday into Monday below advisory; Canoes was 2–3 ft (thigh to waist) this evening and should show bigger, less frequent sets tomorrow. beginner.recommendation: Plan for 7–10 AM: tide still falling from the 4:28 AM high (2.1 ft) with more water over the reef than at the 10:57 AM low (0.5 ft), and model trades a little lighter than midday. Watch several full set cycles before going out: 17–19 s sets can be much bigger than the average and push further inside. One student or a small group of strong adults; several students or children only if sets stay manageable and drift is low. Brown or cloudy water at Canoes or toward the Kūhiō drains / Ala Wai side ends it.
